title: Obstruction map: Standard Model particles and run composites

inputs.role: measured values, compare only (checked against the table)

meta.reading: The defect class of a row is the centre class 6Y mod 6 of the particle, an element of Z6 = Z3 (colour centre) x Z2 (weak centre). The match of defects to particles is a match of centre classes (MATCH.md): the flux defects, the carrier contents, the links and the Higgs register are bosons, and the fermionic quarks and leptons are the quanta whose five-level pattern carries the class (SS). The matches are exact representation comparisons within the stated register; centre class alone does not identify an elementary particle, Lorentz spin, chirality, three generations or empirical mass (CONSOLIDATED_STATUS.md, audit boundary).
meta.unit: Run-data energies in GeV use E* = 1.22089e19 GeV. With one link crossed per tick the tick is hbar/E_cell with E_cell = E* P^(-1/2) = 0.78303 E* at P_fwd, so those values scale by 0.78303 (DC, MATCH.md).
meta.blindness: Measured values are compare-only and NOT BLIND. Worker OM computes no candidate value: every value is quoted from the report named beside it. The build script recomputes the pattern charges and the order of the circulant eigenvalues as checks.

SOURCE.meaning: No measured or declared input beyond the unit E*. Every SOURCE entry names its report and quotes the statement.

CONDITIONAL.meaning: Computed from the source together with the named declared, imported or target-informed items.

FIT.meaning: Chosen against measurement, or computed from inputs chosen against measurement.

OPEN.meaning: No value from the source; the lane that holds the open item is named.

EXCLUDED.meaning: A computed value or construction that the comparison with measurement excludes (value-level status).
EXCLUDED.defined_in: SPECTRUM.md quark row; DF2.md; DG2.md; LNAT2.md

unit_E_star.name: unit E* = 1.22089e19 GeV
unit_E_star.statement: E* is the external unit of the public comparison branch (the Planck energy from the measured G). The status SOURCE admits it.

cubic_arrangement.name: cubic arrangement of carriers (CF-1 architecture)
cubic_arrangement.statement: Carriers sit on the cubic lattice of one of the five frames, a screen cell is the face dual to one crossing link, and one link is crossed per tick. The owner adopts or replaces this architecture (MASS_STEPS.md step A3).

E_cell.name: cell energy E_cell = E* P^(-1/2)
E_cell.statement: E_cell follows exactly from the cubic arrangement, a screen cell dual to one crossing link, one link per tick and E* = hbar c/l* (DC).

pixel_P.name: pixel P_fwd = 1.6309720958588973
pixel_P.statement: P_fwd is the forward root of the declared map P = phi + sqrt(pi) alpha(P) with the Thomson transport. The transport carries the Stage-5 continuation masses with the target-informed Koide balance inside (MAUD section 1.3, rows 2a and 2h). In the modular family R = 2 pi - c ln P the measured alpha^-1(0) is crossed near c = 0.70, which marks the declared P^(1/6) as the member chosen to fit alpha (SC, FIT).

slopes.name: one-loop slopes (33/5, 1, -3) between M_U and m_Z
slopes.statement: The slopes are the MSSM census. The source's census is Standard Model or vector-like: census B rested on a degree-parity grading that equals no rotation of the source (SS). Gauginos are excluded by four routes (DB3, EB), and the edge-sector route gives a shift that is small and nearly universal (EB).

closure_b_above.name: closure reading scale and the unified running b_above = +8.5131
closure_b_above.statement: The m_Z reading of the pixel closure is retired (DC2). The cut closure fixes 1/alpha(E_cell) = 16.2453 and reproduces the producer's chain only with unified running b_above = +8.5131 between E_cell and M_U, which the 12 gauged link currents exclude (GL). An observer-relative area law closes at the cell with the source's couplings (DC3).

R_of_P.name: M_U form, R(P) = ln(E_cell/M_U) = 2 pi - (2/3) ln P
R_of_P.statement: R(P) is excluded as a source scale: the plaquette action makes the couplings equal at the cell and alpha_2 and alpha_3 never meet again below it, so the derived value is R = 0 (SC, under GL's premises). The declared chain keeps R(P).

R_zero.name: unification at the cell (R = 0): E_cell is the only scale the source leaves
R_zero.statement: With GL's plaquette action the three bare couplings are equal at E_cell and b_3 - b_2 < 0 for every census on file, so R = 0 (SC, EXACT). The premise is GL's declared step that makes the continuous port phases a seam register (item su3_links).

transmutation_law.name: transmutation law v = E_cell exp(-2 pi/(beta_EW alpha_U)), beta_EW = 4
transmutation_law.statement: The integer 4 has exact source readings; the law stays declared. Every cell-local mechanism reads the coupling at the cell, which gives v/E* = 6.478e-12, about 3.2e5 times the measured value (SC, NOT BLIND).

one_loop_running.name: one-loop running functional and the imported matching
one_loop_running.statement: The one-loop functional 1/alpha_i(mu) = 1/alpha_U + (b_i/2 pi) ln(M_U/mu) is imported, without thresholds, two-loop terms or scheme matching (DB).

law_selection.name: repair-law choice of the W/Z chart: the zero-selector law
law_selection.statement: The source selects the zero-selector law and excludes the carrier value law (LW: LA1 derived conditional on J_pop, LA2 exact, LA4 derived with one argued premise). Every selection is relative to the declared D10 reference chart.

eta_slice.name: hypercharge slice alpha_Y -> alpha_Y (1 - 2 eta), eta = alpha_U cos 2 theta_W0
eta_slice.statement: The slice entered three days after a recorded Z gap of +0.4645 GeV, which it closes to 101 percent; it is target-informed by timing and by size, and the law-selection principles fix it at zero (LW section 3). Values that carry it are FIT.

vev_attachment.name: v attached at zero momentum transfer through G_F = 1/(sqrt2 v^2)
vev_attachment.statement: The transmutation formula is the one source statement that defines v; the charged and neutral current amplitudes equal 1/(2 v^2) at q^2 = 0 for any couplings (exact tree identity), and G_F does not run under QED (imported). The identification rests on the book's narrative text (LW part b). v_source is 0.153 percent above v_F.

criticality_law.name: double-criticality law lambda = beta_lambda = 0 at a boundary scale
criticality_law.statement: The law has no source derivation at any scale. A bounded class-3 register fixes the quartic at the nonlinear end; criticality needs lambda(E_cell) between 1.9e-4 and 1.2e-2, an almost free scalar that no finite register carries (HT).

criticality_scale.name: criticality boundary at the midpoint mu_c = E* exp(-pi) P^(-1/6)
criticality_scale.statement: The log-midpoint was identified after the two-loop implied scale was computed (MAUD section 5, H2). No pair among E*, E_cell, v_D10 and v_cell has the midpoint as its geometric mean; it needs exactly the declared M_U (HT C2).

d11_readout.name: D11 readout: top-only two-loop running, v at m_t, tree m_H, QCD pole conversion
d11_readout.statement: The D11 engine reads m_t^MSbar = y_t(m_t) v/sqrt2 and m_H = sqrt(2 lambda(m_t)) v at mu = m_t (LEW link L10b). Both Q0 and m_t are readouts that use v; neither is where the source attaches it (LW).

smdr_readout.name: SMDR readout of the declared D10 packet read as Standard Model couplings
smdr_readout.statement: SMDR matching is standard physics with truncations that carry no certified error bound; reading the declared packet as Standard Model MSbar couplings at Q0 is declared (LEW link L6, LW).

radian_per_read.name: unit clock time per tick in a continuous clock generated by the read projector (the radian per read)
radian_per_read.statement: One radian per read is not derived from the stack: it reduces to unit clock time per tick in a continuous clock whose generator is the read projector with coefficient one, a premise with no stack statement behind it (CK). Under it the phase is exactly 2/9 (weak rounds give 2/9 - 35/(2187 N^2)). The modular routes fail exactly: one nat per read needs p = 1/(1 + e) (CK).

generation_register.name: generation register of FR: neutral register F with coupling T, analyzer and screen-tail preparation
generation_register.statement: FR built the two-object register as an exact unitary tick whose one-tick compression is (sqrt2/3) C(theta). The oriented record V is native: the native signed current fixes the coherent record's frame (FR2). The register F, its coupling T and the three-flag analyzer stay declared: no native coupling implements T, and the law performs no entangled two-object readout (FR2, LNAT3). A one-instance dimer chain keeps the circulant shape and loses the count 2/9 (FR2).

register_persistence.name: a law that keeps the register's structure every tick
register_persistence.statement: FR's tick does not keep its compression: with reused records the rotations vanish at tick 2 (LNAT3). With the native-frame record reused the law restores a definite source every second tick and keeps the balance 1/sqrt2 at every odd tick, with phase (j+1) theta and step R^(j+1); a re-preparation that keeps (sqrt2/3) C(theta) per tick is found only as a declared reset (FR2).

a_clock.name: mass read on the energy clock (m proportional to lambda^2)
a_clock.statement: The stack defines rest mass as the coherent rest angular frequency of exp(-itH), and the audit's Higgs memory has the charged-line pole 2 y^2/omega at second order, quadratic in the amplitude (CK, DR). The Floquet clock (14.38, 58.97) and the modular clock (49.64, 141.51) are excluded (CK, NOT BLIND). The stack calls the energy clock a declared replacement clock (CK).

lepton_dressing.name: lepton phase dressing delta = 2/9 - 1.75148e-7
lepton_dressing.statement: No candidate reproduces the dressing (DR, DR2). A branch keeps its clock energy for every environment that commutes with the oriented current J, so the native point is undressed at second order; the shift needs a coupling to J or to the repair record, a change of the read statistics, or a departure from unit clock time (CK). A finite number of weak rounds cannot supply it through the phase (CK).

lepton_scale.name: lepton Yukawa scale y_J: the weight of one unrewarded read
lepton_scale.statement: The missing premise is one number (LS); needed y_J = 0.0107994 at the pole (NOT BLIND). The determinant basepoint 6^-14/2 in native weights fits the leptons and is excluded by the quarks (LS2). Under the committed rule the lepton junction of every lasting (3,3) pair is exactly zero and needs one cost-raising read, whose weight the source does not supply (TR).

junction_ratio.name: lepton/quark junction weight ratio
junction_ratio.statement: The needed ratio y_J^e / tr Y_u is 0.0104 at Q0 and 0.0243 at mu_c (NOT BLIND). Ten registered candidates fail at both scales; every candidate gives equal up and down weights (TR).

quark_branch_magnitude.name: junction magnitude law of the quarks that reads T3 or integer 6Y
quark_branch_magnitude.statement: The seam junction with Higgs memory, colour and class link gives x = 1/2 on every leg (QM, EXACT). The quark sectors need x_u = 0.8316 and x_d = 0.6217 at M_Z and a normalization y_t/y_b of about 59 (NOT BLIND); a branch ratio at a common normalization cannot carry the determinant split (QM, LS2).

up_down_register.name: up/down register finer than Z6 that reaches the observables
up_down_register.statement: Any construction that reads only Z6 labels, colour multiplicity, screen geometry, seam weights and the Higgs orientation predicts equal up and down determinants (LS2). The member interference X exists only between the two quark legs (QM2).

quark_generation_phases.name: quark generation phases and V_CKM: a second junction structure and the quark base spectra
quark_generation_phases.statement: Operators built from one cyclic shift give a permutation and J = 0 (CM). Junctions recorded on different seam objects of FR's register give J != 0, and a single-site junction cannot suppress V_ub (CM2). A bond junction lowers abs(V_ub)/abs(V_cb) to 0.364 against 0.088; the zero that suppresses V_ub also drives J to zero, and abs(V_cb)/abs(V_us) is weight independent at first order, so a single bond cannot reach the measured matrix (CM3).

neutrino_suppression.name: a neutrino-specific amplitude or a register with B - L = -2
neutrino_suppression.statement: y_nu/y_e = 1 in the source (DG2). The fifth-order neutral transfer is the composite's hopping term and the composite has no mass term at any order, so the composite-suppression route is closed (NU3).

neutrino_phase_mixing.name: a second lepton-family structure on the neutral side; the number x of the splitting ratio
neutrino_phase_mixing.statement: The neutral composite's effective Hamiltonian commutes with Y_e Y_e^dag, so U_PMNS is a permutation; mixing needs a second lepton-family structure that breaks the face third-turn and time reversal on the neutral side. The splitting ratio reduces to one uncomputed number x (PM).

su3_links.name: continuous links: the port phases as a seam register
su3_links.statement: The record law's covariance under independent port phases, read on the protected code, gives exactly (SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1))/Z6, and the plaquette action makes the bare couplings equal at the cell. No law writes the continuous port phases; making them a seam register is a declared step (GL).

link_phase_field.name: field step of the continuous links
link_phase_field.statement: With continuous links every wave vector has 24 transverse modes on one cone: two polarizations each for 8 gluons, 3 W and B (GL, EXACT linear analysis). The dynamics run are classical; no confinement, continuum limit or vacuum is shown (GL).

colour_coupling_at_cell.name: the strong coupling at the cell, 1/alpha_3(E_cell) in MSbar
colour_coupling_at_cell.statement: Colour stays finite down to the hierarchy scale only if 1/alpha_3(E_cell) is at least 18.24 for b_3 = -3 (30.40 for -5, 42.55 for -7); the cut closure gives 16.25 and the matched value is 10.15 (SC). The D10 alpha_3 would need 27 to 52 at the cell (HD).

one_cone_per_species.name: one Dirac cone per species (member B of the routing)
one_cone_per_species.statement: Member B (phi = 5 pi/16) leaves one Dirac cone per species, k_c = 1 and b0 = 7, at the price of the declared seam weights cos(3 pi/32) and sin(3 pi/32) and an arrow-toggling Wilson term; adoption is an owner decision (T3).

c_N.name: hadron factors c_N = 2.745(137) and c_rho = 2.273(123) from lattice QCD
c_N.statement: c_h is a number of QCD, imported from lattice results (ALPHA 17 for Lambda^(3), BMW 08 for m_N and m_rho). It applies to the source only if the source's gauge sector below the cell scale is QCD, which has not been shown (HD).

higgs_register.name: Higgs-type register and its common-phase state
higgs_register.statement: A register with the charges of the two spinor levels restores the Gauss constraint; a definite angle needs the register in a state with a common phase (MASS_STEPS.md step E3, R8). Under spin-statistics it is a pointer-free boson register, one per cell (SS). A finite register carries no canonical field pair and no free scalar (HT).

yukawa_amplitudes.name: the junction amplitudes of the Higgs register (Yukawa strengths at the cell)
yukawa_amplitudes.statement: Gauge invariance allows four junction amplitudes and nothing in the program fixes them (MASS_STEPS.md step E3, R8). In the family cell the two Higgs members weigh the same except for one interference term between the two quark legs (QM2).

spin_statistics.name: the spin-statistics connection and the pointer register
spin_statistics.statement: The 2 pi rotation equals (-1)^(number of quanta) on the Gauss sector, and one grading is consistent with it: all 32 patterns odd; register, defects and links even (SS, EXACT). The connection itself and the pointer register remain declared; a filled reference forces the connection (SS).

measured_mt.name: measured top mass 172.1 GeV as input
measured_mt.statement: One measured input, m_t = 172.1 GeV, enters the Higgs mass on the criticality curve (MAUD section 5).

class_identity.label: EXACT
class_identity.quote: On all 32 patterns of the five-level code k = 3 (n2 mod 2) - 2 (n3 mod 3), and the element (omega, -1, exp(2 pi i Y)) acts as the identity on every pattern (EXACT).
class_identity.statement: The defect class of every row is the centre class 6Y mod 6 of its pattern.

match_of_centre_classes.label: EXACT
match_of_centre_classes.quote: The match of defects to particles is a match of centre classes.
match_of_centre_classes.statement: A defect of class k is the flux that the quanta of class k see; the particle names sit on the quanta.

also.quote: The flux defects are bosons; the fermions are the quanta whose five-level pattern carries the class

audit_boundary.label: EXACT
audit_boundary.quote: centre class alone does not identify an elementary particle, Lorentz spin, chirality, three generations or empirical mass.
audit_boundary.statement: The class column of this map is a representation comparison within the stated register; continuous gauge controls, spin pointers, scalar backgrounds, clock phases and unit choices keep their own ancestry.

carrier_neutral.label: EXACT
carrier_neutral.quote: The classes on one carrier add to zero modulo 6, because the carrier is a closed screen.
carrier_neutral.statement: Every carrier content is colour-neutral and weak-neutral.

reactions_are_vertices.label: EXACT
reactions_are_vertices.quote: Reactions are the Standard Model vertices (every one of the 16 reaction types conserves the class)
reactions_are_vertices.statement: The run's reactions 1 + 5 -> 0, 1 + 3 -> 4, 1 + 2 -> 3, 3 + 3 -> 0 and 1 + 1 -> 2 carry the class content of the annihilation, quark mass, quark Yukawa, lepton mass and diquark vertices.

pair_kinds_are_placements.label: EXACT
pair_kinds_are_placements.quote: Quark flavours have no such equal pairs, so a kind is one placement of a meson on a carrier.
pair_kinds_are_placements.statement: The 6 lasting kinds of (2,4) pair and the 5 of (3,3) pair are rotation orbits of non-adjacent face pairs; mirror kinds occur equally often.

b_minus_l.label: EXACT
b_minus_l.quote: One does: B − L = 1 − (2/3) n3 per quantum, which equals N − (2/3)(N_v1 + N_v2 + N_v3).
b_minus_l.statement: The B - L column is 1 - (2/3) n3 of the pattern; every operation of the source conserves it.

also.quote: Every operation conserves B − L. It commutes with the twelve responses, the five level numbers and the toggle.

spin_statistics_grading.label: EXACT
spin_statistics_grading.quote: So the 2π rotation equals (−1)^(number of quanta).
spin_statistics_grading.statement: One grading is consistent with the physical rotation: the 32 patterns of quanta are fermions; the Higgs register, the defects and the links are bosons.
spin_statistics_grading.limits: Spin-statistics itself remains declared, and so does the pointer register (SS).

also.quote: All 32 patterns are odd.
The register, defects and links are even.
Spin-statistics itself remains declared, and so does the pointer register.

flux_contents_are_bosons.label: EXACT
flux_contents_are_bosons.quote: A {2,2,2} or {4,4,4} carrier of pure fluxes cannot be a baryon.
flux_contents_are_bosons.statement: A {4,4,4} or {2,2,2} carrier is a pure-flux boson, and a {3,3} carrier is L Lbar or H Hbar; a baryon is three fermionic quanta on a carrier.

also.quote: It can be L L̄ or H H̄ (bosons).
boson: a pure flux content is no baryon; a baryon is three fermionic quanta on the carrier

higgs_one_register.label: ARGUED
higgs_one_register.quote: The Higgs is a pointer-free register, one per cell (R8): one doublet shared by the copies.
higgs_one_register.statement: The Higgs carries no copy label; the census cannot decide the count and the Higgs count is untested (SS).

also.quote: G2's class 0 (e^c, ν^c) has no flux object, so the source does not realize G2.

census_spin_statistics.label: EXACT
census_spin_statistics.quote: Census B assumes degree-parity statistics, which equals no rotation of the source. Under spin-statistics its scalar partners are excluded.
census_spin_statistics.statement: The source has no boson partner per fermion; its census is 32 fermion patterns per copy (vector-like) or the Standard Model census with complements as holes.

also.quote: Adjoint sectors are always even, so odd adjoint link states are excluded.

koide_weights.label: EXACT
koide_weights.quote: On an active seam, the agreeing branch (record 0) and the repair branch (record 1) each have weight 1/2. This holds for both load positions and both address orientations. The repair amplitude carries the sign of orientation times source endpoint. On the native code a seam is active with probability 1/3, so the weights are agree 1/6 and repair 1/12 + 1/12, on both the C and E seams.
koide_weights.statement: The branch weights of the coherent seam event, 1/6 : 1/12 : 1/12, are source-level; arranged as the circulant they give abs(b)/a = 1/sqrt2.
koide_weights.limits: The circulant with Q = 2/3 needs the family register: the law's own records alone give Q = 0.343 to 0.346 (LNAT2), and FR's register is a declared construction that holds for one tick (LNAT3).

also.quote: The record bit gives |b|/a = 1/√2 with no coin.
on an active seam the agreeing branch (record 0) and the repair branch (record 1, two orientations at 1/12 each) have equal weight 1/6 : 1/6, so p0 = pc = 1/2.

The branch weights are SOURCE: the coherent seam event's agreeing and repair branches weigh 1/2 each on an active seam (agree 1/6, repair 1/12 + 1/12), and arranged as the circulant they give abs(b)/a = 1/sqrt2 and Q = 2/3 with no coin

fr_register.label: EXACT
fr_register.quote: Its one-tick compression onto the characters of the face third-turn is exactly the target circulant with |b|/a = 1/√2 (EXACT).
fr_register.statement: FR's two-object register is an exact unitary tick inside the coherent law whose one-tick compression is (sqrt2/3) C(theta), with Q = 2/3 for every theta in the positive chamber.
fr_register.limits: The register, its coupling and the analyzer are declared (FR); only the oriented record V is native (LNAT3, FR2).

also.quote: The coherent event is a SWAP, so the source endpoint is recorded (EXACT, new).
FR's analyzer has Schmidt rank 2 across the two objects (EXACT).
V is native. Of the three open pieces, none exists in the form the register needs

one_tick_only.label: EXACT
one_tick_only.quote: the rotations vanish at tick 2 and the three masses become equal (EXACT).
one_tick_only.statement: The circulant does not persist past one tick of FR's register.

also.quote: Parts of the register are declared and the structure holds for one tick.

clock_premise.label: EXACT
clock_premise.quote: It reduces to one undeclared item: unit clock time per tick in a continuous clock whose generator is the read projector with coefficient one.
clock_premise.statement: The radian per read is one premise. Under it the phase is exactly 2/9, the masses are read on the energy clock, and the native point is undressed at second order.

also.quote: Under that premise the phase is exactly 2/9, the masses are read on the same clock (energy reading, Q = 2/3), and a branch keeps its clock energy during a virtual excitation.

lepton_characters.label: EXACT
lepton_characters.quote: For a defect on f, the electron is the g-character w², the muon w and the tau trivial; on f′ the electron and muon labels swap.
lepton_characters.statement: The generation characters of the charged leptons, in the characters of g = gE gC.

also.quote: τ sits on the axial character f₀ whenever θ lies in (−π/3, π/3).

koide_operator_condition.label: EXACT
koide_operator_condition.quote: With the source endpoint undetermined (the native code, or any source-symmetric readout), the family operator is a quadrature operator: Q in [0.343, 0.346] and every mass ratio below phi^2 = 2.618, for every clock phase.
koide_operator_condition.statement: From its own records the coherent law gives a quadrature operator; measurement excludes it at every clock phase.

no_algebraic_two_ninths.label: EXACT
no_algebraic_two_ninths.quote: Theorem (EXACT). If z is a nonzero algebraic number, then arg z is not 2/9 rad (modulo 2 pi).
no_algebraic_two_ninths.statement: A phase of 2/9 rad needs a transcendental element, in practice a continuous clock; every finite algebraic part of the law gives other phases.

w_w2_split.label: EXACT
w_w2_split.quote: w and w^2 split for the link classes 1, 2, 4, 5. They do not split for k = 0, for class 3, or for any register defect, which the walk does not read.
w_w2_split.statement: A link-phase defect of a quark class splits the two complex characters through its Aharonov-Bohm phase pi k/9 with abs(b)/a = 1/55; the lepton class keeps them paired.

charged_lepton.statement: In the characters of g = gE gC and for a defect on the face f = {4,5,11}, the electron is w^2, the muon w and the tau the trivial character; on the antipodal face f' the electron and muon labels swap (FR item 8, EXACT in the declared register). The tau stays on the trivial character for every theta in (-pi/3, pi/3) (PM A0).

neutrino.statement: The neutral composite's effective Hamiltonian commutes with Y_e Y_e^dag, so the neutrino copies sit on the charged-lepton characters and the PMNS matrix is a permutation, which measurement excludes (PM A1).

quark.statement: In every site reading at theta = 2/9 the up and down sectors put their light, middle and heavy levels on the same characters (CM2); the base spectra of the two sectors are not derived (QM, QM2).

higgs.statement: Under spin-statistics the Higgs is a pointer-free register, one per cell: one doublet shared by the copies. The census cannot decide the count (SS).

gauge.statement: A gauge field is a response on the five levels; the map assigns it no copy label.

composite.statement: The class content of a carrier carries no generation (MATCH.md, GEN).

fermion.statement: A quantum of any of the 32 patterns has the pointer doublet as spin and is a fermion: the one grading that equals the 2 pi rotation on the Gauss sector (SS, EXACT). The pointer register and the antisymmetric lift are declared.

scalar.statement: The Higgs as the R8 register has no pointer and is a boson under the one spin-statistics grading (SS, EXACT); the register is declared.

vector.statement: Link states have integer spin and are bosons (SS, EXACT); the vector character with two polarizations is imported from GL and X5.

composite.statement: A defect of any class and every carrier content of pure fluxes has integer spin and is a boson, given spin-statistics (SS, EXACT).

baryon.statement: A baryon is three quanta on a carrier: half-integer spin, fermion (SS).

meson.statement: A meson is a quantum with an antiquantum: an even number of fermionic quanta, a boson (SS grading); the spin value is the Standard Model one (IMPORTED).
